The transaction behavior contains signals compatible with the documented account-takeover candidate pattern. The candidate remains an inference and is not itself a fraud verdict.
The identity record contains id_15=New. This is treated as an observed identity/device indicator and not as proof of unauthorized activity.
The identity record contains a proxy/anonymous network-related value. The field is preserved as an observed signal; its undocumented semantics are not expanded beyond the recorded value.
